title: ProfileGuardrails
description: Wire contract for POST /v1/profile-guardrails. The request is a single whole-text { text } body — the sidecar has no per-field map, and a drifted client 422s against the strict request model (app/validation.py GuardrailsRequest). The response carries the two yes/no judgments for that text (app/schemas.py GuardrailsOut). The root schema validates the RESPONSE; $defs/request validates the REQUEST. A TypeScript client (lib/guardrails.ts) is built against the same shapes; the pytest contract test validates live requests and responses against this file with additionalProperties: false everywhere.

text.description: The free-text field content to judge. Beyond 2000 chars the sidecar answers 422 rather than truncate.

matched.description: Named deterministic contact detectors that fired (email, url, handle, phone); a model-only backstop hit yields [].
